clue.text: Dolt? One male celeb, I suspect

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: used as an adjective, suspect means dubious or not genuine, so the letters of celeb and I are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone eyes a famous man and privately suspects he is a fool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspect' reads as a verb in the surface, but here it is an adjective meaning dubious, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A dolt is a stupid person, and an idiot of that kind is a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Popular photograph published

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a print is a photograph developed on paper

explanation.surface: A well-liked photograph has been published.
explanation.definitionFit: A book that is available from the publisher has been published and is still on sale.

clue.text: Captain of industry in public house, working

parts.note: a bar is a pub or the room in it
on means functioning or working

explanation.surface: A tycoon is found in the pub, still working.
explanation.definitionFit: A powerful businessman, such as an oil or press magnate, is called a baron.

clue.text: Psychics at vicar's, only in disguise!

indicators.note: in disguise means given a false appearance, so the letters of at vicar's only are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fortune tellers are present at the vicarage, but only when disguised.
explanation.definitionFit: People claiming to see the future or the unseen are psychics or seers.

clue.text: Pick up knight after king

indicators.note: after puts the knight's letter behind the king's name

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's King Lear
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A chess player masters a move, playing the knight after the king.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up a skill or language is to acquire it by study.

clue.text: Father and son, second to qualify

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
S is the abbreviation for second, the unit of time

explanation.surface: A father and his son both hope to be the next to gain a qualification.
explanation.definitionFit: To get through an exam or test is to qualify, as in making the grade.

clue.text: Funny, a reflection

parts.note: musing is thoughtful reflection

explanation.surface: Someone finds a passing thought funny.
explanation.definitionFit: Something comical that raises a smile is funny in the light sense.

clue.text: Small aquatic bird in rear of vessel

parts.note: a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A little seabird perches at the back of a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The back end of a ship or boat is its stern, the opposite of the bow.

clue.text: Exaggerate the advice of one who loves lots of butter?

definitions.meaning: to overstate or overdo praise or emotion

definitions.text: the advice of one who loves lots of butter?
definitions.meaning: a butter lover would tell you to spread it generously on bread

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for overstating something pictures a thick layer, which suits a lover of butter literally.

clue.text: Hoodie in area next to recreation ground

indicators.note: next to places the abbreviation for area directly after the park

parts.note: a park is a public recreation ground

explanation.surface: A youth in a hooded top hangs around an area beside the playing fields.
explanation.definitionFit: A hooded windproof jacket is the garment, a hoodie in the broad sense of a coat with a hood.

clue.text: Generally a game may be found in auction

indicators.note: may be found in places the game's abbreviation inside the word for an auction

parts.note: a sale is an auction of goods
RU is rugby union, the game

explanation.surface: Collectors say that, generally, a board game turns up at a house auction.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means usually or in most cases, which is what generally conveys.

clue.text: Part of domain name for hostelry

indicators.note: part of signals that the answer is a run of letters taken from the words domain name

explanation.surface: A pub chooses part of its internet domain name.
explanation.definitionFit: A hostelry is an old-fashioned word for a pub or tavern offering lodging.

clue.text: Performance of editor in broadcast about foremost of newspapers

indicators.note: about means going round, so the rearranged letters surround the first letter of newspapers
broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of editor and in are thrown into a new order
foremost of picks out the leading letter of newspapers

explanation.surface: An editor's live broadcast performance is reported in the front pages of the papers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' looks like a noun for a programme, but it scatters the letters; 'about' then wraps the shuffled letters round the newspaper's initial.
explanation.definitionFit: A rendering or interpretation of a song or piece of music is a performance of it.

clue.text: First-class spinner following helpful hint

indicators.note: following puts the spinning toy after the hint

parts.note: a tip is a useful piece of advice
a top is a toy that spins

explanation.surface: A first-class cricket spinner bowls after getting a useful hint.
explanation.definitionFit: Excellent or of the highest quality, the idiom means first-class.

clue.text: A host at last in position to calm down

indicators.note: in puts the A and the last letter of host inside the word for position

parts.note: a place is a position

indicators.note: at last takes the final letter of host

explanation.surface: A host finally gets into position to calm a guest down.
explanation.definitionFit: To pacify or appease an angry person is to calm them down.

clue.text: Overlook smithy, first in town

parts.note: a forge is a blacksmith's workshop

indicators.note: first in takes the opening letter of town

explanation.surface: Visitors are told not to miss the smithy, the first sight in town.
explanation.definitionFit: To overlook something is to fail to remember or neglect it.

clue.text: Agency worker set off in violent storm

parts.note: a temp is a temporary worker supplied by an agency

indicators.note: off means wrong or awry, so the letters of set are rearranged

explanation.surface: An agency temp heads out into a fierce storm.
explanation.definitionFit: A tempest is a literary word for a fierce storm with strong winds.

clue.text: Have something to do with act?

definitions.meaning: to be involved in or contribute to some matter
to act is to take a role on stage

explanation.definitionFit: Being involved in an outcome and performing a role in a play both use the same idiom.

clue.text: Ring after annoying person gives one sauce

indicators.note: after places the ring's letter behind the nuisance

parts.note: a pest is a nuisance
O is a ring from its shape

explanation.surface: A pest keeps ringing until someone hands over the sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Basil sauce from Genoa, served with pasta, is a kind of sauce.

clue.text: Expert wearing a new protective garment

indicators.note: wearing means that the expert sits inside, clothed by, the A and N

parts.note: a pro is a professional, an expert

explanation.surface: A professional puts on a fresh protective garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A cook's or smith's garment tied over clothes to keep them clean is protective.

clue.text: Presumably contains a quantity of money

indicators.note: contains signals that the answer sits inside the word Presumably

explanation.surface: Someone guesses that a purse presumably holds some cash.
explanation.definitionFit: An amount of cash is often called a sum, as in a large sum.

clue.text: Onset of shower affected little monkey

indicators.note: onset of takes the first letter of shower

parts.note: camp means affected or exaggerated in manner

explanation.surface: A rain shower begins and the small monkey reacts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little monkey' is the affectionate term for a mischievous child, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rascal or mischievous child is playfully called a little monkey.

clue.text: Course race official

definitions.meaning: the first dish of a meal, a course
the person who gets a race going by firing a pistol or dropping a flag

explanation.definitionFit: An appetiser served first and the official who begins a race share one name.

clue.text: Furious, judge on island

indicators.note: on puts the word for judge next to the island's letter

parts.note: to rate is to judge or assess

explanation.surface: A judge stuck on an island is furious about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Angry in the extreme; furious and this word are close synonyms.

clue.text: Old writer ready to entertain new ideas?

parts.note: a pen is a writing implement

explanation.surface: An elderly author is still receptive to fresh thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Being open-minded means being receptive to fresh thinking.

clue.text: Wife moved out of Twin Peaks, dreadfully dangerous place

indicators.note: dreadfully means badly, so the remaining letters are put into disorder
moved out of says the wife's letter leaves the words Twin Peaks

explanation.surface: A wife has moved out of the town in the TV drama Twin Peaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moved out of' removes W from TWIN PEAKS, leaving TINPEAKS, which 'dreadfully' rearranges. Twin Peaks is an American TV series.
explanation.definitionFit: A pit full of serpents is a literal hazard and, figuratively, any perilous situation.
